title: CryptoScan State Machine Register
principles: Every state is observed from code — models, enums, declared tuples, comments or write sites. Nothing is invented.
'partial' means the observed vocabulary is a subset; 'unobserved' means the field exists but its vocabulary is not yet known. Both are honest; guessing is not.
unknown is never zero. A failed read is a failure. Absence is never a clean result. Capability is never usage. A refusal is counted, never drawn as a truth.

progress.meaning: In flight. Neither a verdict nor an absence.

done.meaning: Reached a terminal good state, or a steady state in good standing.

failure.meaning: The thing itself failed — terminal, counted, drawn as failure.

stopped.meaning: Ended by a decision. Neither success nor failure.

warn.meaning: Degraded, risky or ageing. Visible, never silent.

unknown.meaning: Not measured, not knowable, or contradictory. NEVER zero, never clean.

refused.meaning: An authority said no. Counted; never drawn as a truth about the estate.

absent.meaning: Not present, not configured or not attempted. Absence is never a clean result.

derived.meaning: Computed from other facts, not itself observed.

capability.meaning: Present as a capability. NEVER means used.

stale.meaning: Evidence aged out; the reading may no longer hold.

machines.label: Tenant resolution
machines.description: Which tenant this console session reads. The whole UI hangs off it.

states.meaning: No ACTIVE membership for this session — reads stay refusals, never zeros.
Asked the membership list; answer not back yet.
First ACTIVE membership adopted. Never guessed, never defaulted.

transitions.trigger: console asks for this session's tenant
first ACTIVE membership arrives; setActiveTenantId stores it

invariants: A tenant is resolved or it is not: there is no guessed tenant.
Reads with a blank tenant are failures, never zeros.

machines.label: Read health
machines.description: Whether the last read succeeded. The honesty rule the whole UI is built on.
machines.vocabulary_source: frontend/src/lib/api.ts ApiResult + pages' Read failed states

states.meaning: The read failed. The screen says so; it never prints zeros instead.

invariants: A failed read is a failure — it never prints zeros.
An empty result is not a clean estate; it is labelled absence.

machines.label: Write feedback
machines.description: What the console may claim after a write attempt.

states.meaning: The server rejected the draft; the draft is retained.
Authentication/authorization refused the write; authority must be re-established.
No confirmation either way — the server may already have retained the write.

invariants: An unconfirmed write is unknown: never shown as done, never as failed.
Drafts are retained across validation and authority failures.

machines.label: Flow stage
machines.description: The five states every journey track, ladder and rail in the console draws.

states.meaning: This stage was reached and recorded.
Not reached yet — by design, not by failure.
No evidence either way. Not observed is never 'didn't run'.

invariants: Only reached stages are drawn done; the rest stay dashed unknown.
Installed is not executed — a reached stage is a measurement, not a claim.

machines.label: Performance tile state
machines.description: How a performance tile states what kind of number it is showing.

states.meaning: Computed from other facts; the tile says so.
Not measured. The tile draws unknown — never a zero.

invariants: Unknown tiles never render 0.
Derived values are labelled derived, never presented as measured.

machines.label: Tone vocabulary
machines.description: Every colour word the console resolves, resolved once, so a state looks the same everywhere.
invariants: An alias never invents a state: muted/unknown/none map to slate — never to a pass or a failure.
A word that names no colour renders neutral — a typo cannot hide a value or paint it green.

machines.label: Surface maturity
machines.description: Support classification of every console route.

states.meaning: Shipped and supported; the limit is stated with the surface.
Reserved for a stated limited deployment. No shipped surface uses it.
Default for unknown: unknown routes classify down, never up.

invariants: A surface is never promoted by silence: unknown defaults down to preview.
The limitation stays with the surface instead of a beta badge.

machines.label: Scan lifecycle
machines.description: One scan request, from queue to terminal state.
machines.vocabulary_source: tuple SCAN_STATUSES + CheckConstraint scans_status_check + Scan methods

states.meaning: Created and waiting for a worker.
A worker holds it (compare-and-set on the scan's version).
Finished. Says nothing about whether the estate is clean.

invariants: The scan row's lifecycle is about the scan job — never evidence that the estate is clean.
The declared tuple and the database CHECK constraint must stay in step (scan.py).

machines.label: Scan job outcome
machines.description: The worker-side job row behind a scan.
machines.vocabulary_source: model default + worker write sites + migration 0106

states.meaning: Outcome could not be established (migration 0106 allows it).

invariants: An unknown job outcome is UNKNOWN — never coerced to FAILED or to a zero.
Every status write is a compare-and-set on the version it read: a stale worker cannot overwrite a later verdict.

machines.label: Live scan session
machines.description: A live-host validation run. Validates one capture only — never a fleet.

states.meaning: The runner could not be reached — absence, not a clean result.

machines.label: Collection surface progress
machines.description: Whether a declared collection surface actually produced anything.
invariants: NOT_ATTEMPTED is an absence — never drawn as a clean surface.

machines.label: Collection phase
machines.description: Which phase of a collection a receipt records.

states.meaning: The host-key phase of a collection.

machines.label: Collector depth ladder
machines.description: How deep a collector actually reaches, per crypto family.

states.meaning: Family partly reachable; not on the ladder.
The artifact exists (registration only — never runtime use).
Rows were ingested, no call-level evidence.
Call-level reach — the deepest measured stage.

invariants: Installed is not executed: only call-level reach counts as observed use.
Stages past the measurement are drawn dashed unknown — 'not observed', never 'didn't run'.

machines.label: Binary scan lifecycle
machines.description: A binary/devsecops analysis run.
machines.vocabulary_source: model default COMPLETED + binary_job.py write sites

states.meaning: Analysis finished — verdicts live in the findings, not here.

machines.label: Capability vs usage
machines.description: The names carry the claim: how strong the evidence is that a crypto capability is actually used.

states.meaning: Library or feature present. Not use.
Symbol imported/used in static views. Still not observed use.
Observed at runtime — dynamic evidence only.
Could not be attributed either way.

invariants: Capability never promotes to usage.
runtime_confirmed is raised ONLY by observed runtime events — and never overwrites a static row.

machines.label: Evidence class
machines.description: Strength-of-evidence classes shared by binary findings.

states.meaning: Not seen in what was examined.

invariants: not_detected is never proof of absence.
inferred and indicated are drawn as derived, never as observations.

machines.label: OS-CRYPTO rule evaluation
machines.description: Whether an OS-CRYPTO rule could be evaluated at all.

states.meaning: The rule ran against real evidence. The detection answer lives beside it.
Required evidence is missing. NOT a clean result.

invariants: not_evaluable is never clean.
OS-CRYPTO-017 stays not_evaluable until a runtime session exists: 'not detected' is not 'absent'.
OS-CRYPTO rules are detections, never verdicts.

machines.label: OS rule evidence class
machines.description: What the evidence behind an OS-CRYPTO detection actually shows.

states.meaning: The evidence was collected and shows the condition.
Evidence points at the condition without showing it.
Not seen in the collected evidence — never proof of absence.

invariants: not_detected ≠ absent; the wording on screen keeps the difference.

machines.label: OS record state
machines.description: State of a collected OS module or trust fact (/proc/crypto is registrations, not runtime use).

states.meaning: Module/trust record loaded from the collection.
Could not be collected — absence of data, not absence of risk.
Feature/registration enabled (a registration, never runtime use).

machines.label: Verification result
machines.description: Outcomes of evidence and remediation verification.

states.meaning: Verification was impossible — never a pass.
A remediation was verified as done.

invariants: UNVERIFIABLE is unknown, never a pass and never a failure.
EMPTY is labelled absence — an empty result, not a clean estate.

machines.label: Control finding state

states.meaning: The bank decided the control's setting.

A reading the collector could not take.

invariants: NOT_CONFIGURED and UNKNOWN are different: the first is a decision the bank has not made, the second is a reading the collector could not take. Collapsing them is how a gap gets reported as a policy.

machines.label: PQC migration wave
machines.description: One wave of the PQC migration plan. The wave is a plan object: its states say where the plan stands, never where the estate stands.

states.meaning: On the plan; the work has not been attempted yet. A plan is never progress.
Work is in flight. Neither a verdict nor an absence.
Every progress claim on the wave carries a verified verdict and an operator confirmed the wave. Written only by that action.
An open blocker stops the wave. Counted, never hidden.
Replaced by a newer plan. Ended by a decision, not by success.

transitions.trigger: operator confirms the wave over verified progress
operator marks the wave blocked while a blocker is open
operator resumes the wave after the blocker clears

invariants: A verified wave is written only by an operator confirmation backed by verified progress records — nothing promotes it automatically.
A plan object is never drawn as estate state.

machines.label: PQC migration blocker
machines.description: Something blocking a migration wave: raised explicitly, resolved explicitly.

states.meaning: Blocking a wave. Counted, never hidden.
Cleared against evidence by an explicit action.
Residual risk accepted by an accountable owner — a recorded decision, never a silent close.

transitions.trigger: operator clears the blocker against evidence
an accountable owner accepts the residual risk

invariants: An accepted blocker is a recorded governance decision, never a silent close.

machines.label: PQC progress claim
machines.description: A progress claim on a wave and its verification verdict. The claim is asserted; only the verification action writes a verdict, and verified requires an evidence reference.

states.meaning: A claim exists. Asserted, not yet checked — never drawn as progress proven.
Checked against an evidence reference by an explicit verification action.
Checked and not true. A failure of the claim, counted.
The verifying evidence was withdrawn or superseded; the verdict may no longer hold.

transitions.trigger: verification finds the claim not true
the verifying evidence is withdrawn or superseded
the claim is re-recorded with new evidence
re-verification finds the claim not true

invariants: A recorded claim is not progress proven.
Only the verification action writes verified — and only with an evidence reference. A verdict without evidence is refused.

machines.label: Binary scan job status
machines.description: The durable queue row behind an artifact scan (bjob-...).
machines.vocabulary_source: model default + durable_queue.py enqueue/claim/complete/fail/reap write sites

states.meaning: Waiting — and where a retryable failure returns the job while attempts remain.
Leased by a named worker under a lease.
Finished; the run summary is persisted on the row.
Terminal failure — counted by the dead-letter read.

invariants: Nothing stays QUEUED/CLAIMED forever: leases expire and the reaper reclaims work.
A retryable failure returns the job to QUEUED with attempts counted; DEAD is the honest end of that budget — never an infinite retry.
Every status transition is a compare-and-set on the version it read: a stale worker cannot overwrite a later verdict.
